title: Go Play GTA 6, Wardogs Developer Tells Fans for December
description: Following the success of Wardogs, developer Bulkhead is taking December off and humorously telling their fans to go play GTA 6 to detox.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Well-Deserved Break for the Bulkhead Team

After the runaway success of Wardogs, a new sandbox multiplayer shooter currently in Early Access on PC, the team at Bulkhead is taking a well-deserved break. The studio is preparing to take the entire month of December off to recharge and reset after the intense effort of launching and managing their latest title.

However, the developers didn't just announce their downtime; they also had a special recommendation for their community. In a lighthearted message to their fans, the team made it clear that players can take a break, too, famously suggesting that everyone go play GTA 6.

## Industry Context and Perspective

While the mention of GTA 6 highlights the massive shadow and cultural footprint that Rockstar Games' upcoming title casts over the entire gaming landscape, it also underscores a healthy attitude toward gaming consumption. Developers and players alike occasionally need to step away from the grind of live-service and early access titles.

Bulkhead's candid approach serves as a reminder that the gaming community thrives when both creators and players embrace balance, taking time off to explore other incredible virtual worlds.

## Editor's Take

It is always refreshing to see a game development studio prioritize well-being and encourage their community to take a breather. Suggesting that fans go play GTA 6 while the studio takes December off is a fun, relatable way to handle a seasonal shutdown.
